notes.title: Play the The House of Hamelin Demo at Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]You will be able to play the demo for [b]The House of Hamelin[/b] during Steam’s Next Fest, October 13th - 20th! Save your cat from a house filled with monsters, in this deckbuilding, horror, roguelite.  [/p][previewyoutube="5Fsa5G8o2Wc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233300/The_House_of_Hamelin/" style="button"]Wishlist now on Steam![/url][/p]
